purpose: Classify every current Skill top-level entry before physical template-source and copyable-distribution separation.
requiredSeparationRules: The branch root becomes the template-product source artifact rather than an installable Skill directory.
The contents of template are copied byte-for-byte to a concrete Skill root.
No required reference below template may escape template.
Publication integration and source-only conformance infrastructure remain outside template.
The profile model retains instruction-only as exclusive and combines other selected profiles by the union of required contracts.
Clean-room concrete-Skill conformance starts from template rather than the complete branch root.
Template consumers prune unsupported optional contracts only after copying the closed distribution artifact.
